title: Completed Sustainability and ESG Management Plan Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed Sustainability and ESG Management Plan artifact data payloads (PMO-04.12.01).

sustainability_vision_and_regulatory_bas.description: The organizational ESG mandate, environmental regulatory frameworks, and statutory compliance standards governing the project.

carbon_footprint_reduction_target.description: Quantified greenhouse gas (GHG) emission reduction targets spanning direct execution (Scope 1/2) and supply chain operations (Scope 3).

circular_economy_and_material_strategy.description: Policies governing zero-waste design, sustainable material selection, energy efficiency, and asset recycling / reuse pathways.

social_impact_and_community_engagement.description: Measures ensuring positive community impact, workforce diversity, labor safety standards, and local stakeholder benefits.

ethical_procurement_and_supplier_esg_sta.description: Mandatory vendor qualification criteria regarding human rights, fair labor practices, and sustainable supply chain transparency.

esg_risk_and_compliance_monitoring.description: Specific environmental and social risk exposures, mitigation plans, and regulatory inspection cadences.

esg_key_performance_indicators.description: Measurable scorecard tracking energy consumption, carbon offsets, diversity ratios, and ethical audit scores across sprints.

sustainable_decommissioning_and_handover.description: Procedures ensuring environmentally responsible asset disposal, data purging, and ecological post-project decommissioning.

sustainability_audit_lead_and_review_cad.description: The designated sustainability officer accountable for compliance audits and the periodic ESG review schedule.
